page1_img_1.png.title: Data sharing continuum: None → Status Quo → Goal → Ideal
page1_img_1.png.description: A horizontal continuum bar with four labeled stages: 'None' at the red left end, 'Status Quo' in brown, then 'Goal' and 'Ideal' in progressively darker green at the right. The segment between Status Quo and Goal is overlaid with diagonal hatching and a dashed arrow above it labeled 'Goal for SE Research' pointing from the Status Quo toward the Goal, while short vertical posts mark the stage boundaries. The diagram visually encodes the paper’s point that the community currently sits near the Status Quo and should move rightward toward the Goal (and ultimately the Ideal) in the amount and quality of data and tool sharing.
